name: Item Required Target
description: Restricts an item's on-use spell to specific targets: the item can only be used while targeting one of the listed creature entries, either alive or dead depending on the type. Loaded by ObjectMgr::LoadItemRequiredTarget.

fields.name: Item
fields.help: The item whose use is restricted (item_template.entry).

fields.name: Type
fields.help: Whether the required target must be a living creature or a dead one.

fields.name: Target Entry
fields.help: Creature entry the item must be targeting.
